## Summary Issue #483: `pkg show`, `pkg import`, and `pkg pull` printed sender-chosen `Proposal.Summary`, `ProposedBy`, and course `Name`/`Detail` raw. A CR, newline, ESC, or bidi override in that text could repaint the sealer fingerprint, including on a package the gate later refuses. Those fields now go through the existing `UntrustedText.ForConsole` helper before they are printed. Seal checks and admission decisions are unchanged. `layer-boundary / verify` will be red. This is a host change under `application/src/Ashlar.CLI`, and that check is not required on `master`. The change is intended: it closes the print sites #483 names, and it reuses the helper that was added for this class of text instead of a second escaper. `pkg export`, `pkg share`, and `pkg publish` still print `Proposal.Summary` raw; those verbs were not in the issue. ## Changes - `PkgCommand` runs the import peek, `pkg show`, and each `pkg pull` row through `UntrustedText.ForConsole`. - `UntrustedText` docs now name those call sites. The helper still replaces C0 controls (CR, LF, ESC, NUL), DEL, C1 CSI, and bidi overrides (`U+202A`–`U+202E`, `U+2066`–`U+2069`) with U+FFFD and keeps the readable text. - `PkgCommandTests` cover a refused package and a held pull row so a hostile summary cannot forge or overwrite the fingerprint line. - Knowledge graph regenerated for the test edit. ## Testing `scripts/test-in-container.sh --repo /tmp/ashlar-pkg-clone --project application/src/Ashlar.Tests.CLI/Ashlar.Tests.CLI.csproj --framework net10.0 --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~PkgCommandTests'` Passed: 17, failed: 0, skipped: 0. Three mutation checks, each applied once, went red on the new assertion and green after restore: dropping `Safe()` around `ProposedBy` on `pkg show`, dropping `Safe()` around course detail on the import peek, and printing the pull summary raw. The raw-summary red run contained a CR, and the forged fingerprint text overwrote the real one on the HELD row. ### Testing strategy (blast radius) See [Testing strategy pivot v1](docs/architecture/TestingStrategyPivot-v1.md). | Change type | Minimum proof (check what applies) | |-------------|-------------------------------------| | `Ashlar.Core.Domain` | `dotnet test src/Ashlar.Tests.Domain` · `make kernel-coverage-gate` | | Infrastructure adapter (small / branchy) | Focused unit or gap test in touched file · coverage gate | | Hosting / API / routing / barriers / `AddAshlar` | `make test-prod-style` and/or `make application-gate-tier-c` | | Docker / mesh / fleet / trust | `make mesh-lab-e2e` or relevant `*-gate` tier (see pivot doc) | | Megaclass (`ProviderFactory`, Docker provisioners, …) | **ProdStyle / virtual host** — do not add new `*GapCoverageTests` files | - [x] Focused CLI tests for the print sites (command output only; no kernel or hosting change) - [ ] `make kernel-coverage-gate` (if touching `src/Ashlar.Core.*` or `src/Ashlar.Infrastructure`) - [ ] `make kernel-gate` (if touching kernel hosting / pipeline / profiles) - [ ] `make test-prod-style` (if touching production DI / API / routing) ## Checklist - [x] Focused `Ashlar.Tests.CLI` filter passes in the devtest container - [x] Knowledge graph regenerated - [x] No `TODO` or `NotImplementedException` left unresolved - [x] Breaking changes are documented — none; hostile bytes render as U+FFFD ## Release (only when this PR ships a **versioned** NuGet/GHCR release) - [x] Not a versioned release — skip
